snippet.title: ToneTrek – Early Access Launch Trailer 🧩 Now on Steam with 40% OFF!
snippet.description:
🟢 ToneTrek is now available in Early Access on Steam – with a 40% launch discount!
Step into a world of color-based logic puzzles where every move transforms the board. Minimalistic design, deep strategy, and handcrafted challenges await.

🧩 What’s included in Early Access:
– 50 handcrafted levels
– Multiple game modes: Free, Moves Limit, Time Limit
– Save/load support + campaign mode
– Full localization in 10 languages
– New UI, smoother menus, and polish!

🎮 Play the free demo or dive into the full version now!
🛒 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3851630/ToneTrek
🌐 Online Demo: https://darkwatersgames.com/tonetrek

Follow us for updates, and let us know your feedback!
#ToneTrek #EarlyAccess #PuzzleGame #SteamRelease #LogicPuzzle #IndieGame #MadeWithGodot #steamdemo
